record.issue_text: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1078 — When neither eventType nor organizer has a destinationCalendar, evt.destinationCalendar is null, so `?.push` silently discards every other collective host's calendar and they get no event.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around the shown diff). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code tries to add other hosts’ calendars via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is skipped, so any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are never attached to `evt` even when other collective hosts have `user.destinationCalendar`. This matches the finding’s claim that other hosts’ destination calendars get dropped in that scenario.
